_comment: Edit this file with your own fixed evaluation questions. Run: python scripts/legal_eval.py [--full]. Each question needs an 'expect' block; every expectation field is optional — only the ones present are scored.

_fields.question: the exact question to ask
_fields.expect.source: filename (or substring) that must appear in the retrieved sources
_fields.expect.page_min / expect.page_max: page range the answer should come from
_fields.expect.must_include_terms: facts/phrases a good answer must contain (scores completeness + specificity)
_fields.expect.separate_labels: category/contract names that must stay separate — each must be retrieved and, in --full mode, appear in the answer
_fields.expect.answer_absent: true = the documents do NOT contain this; a good answer must say so
_fields.expect.type: comparison | when_to_use | what_changed | obligations — checked against the template detector

questions.question: When should an authority use the Model Services Contract instead of the Mid-Tier or Short Form Contract?
What changed in version 2.2A because of the Procurement Act 2023?
What does the guidance say about cryptocurrency payments?
Compare the Model Services Contract, the Mid-Tier Contract and the Short Form Contract in a table.
On which page does the guidance set the contract-value threshold for the Model Services Contract, and what is that threshold?
What criminal penalties does the guidance impose on suppliers for late delivery?
What does counsel's advisory opinion conclude about enforcing the liability cap in the Orion / Novael Master Services Agreement?
questions._note: Source is a privileged opinion (frontmatter privileged: true); in --full mode the answer should flag the source as privileged. must_include_terms target the real legal basis so retrieval-only mode still scores.
